programs.title: The 300 Spartans
programs.desc: Historical drama with Ralph Richardson. A retelling of the stand made at Thermopylae in 480 BC by a small Greek force against invasion by an enormous Persian army.

programs.title: Flight of the Phoenix
programs.desc: Drama. Dennis Quaid stars as the captain of an aircraft downed in the desert. There's no hope of rescue, unless he and the survivors can build another plane from the wreckage.

programs.title: The Woman King
programs.desc: Historical action starring Viola Davis. An elite force of female warriors, the Agojie, protect their West African kingdom from threats from rival kingdoms and from European slavers.

programs.title: Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children
programs.desc: Eva Green and Asa Butterfield star in Tim Burton's fantasy adventure. A teenager enters the magical, but scary and violent, world where his grandfather grew up.

programs.title: The Neon Bible
programs.desc: The moving story of a boy (Jacob Tierney) whose life in America's bible belt in the 1940s is profoundly affected by his parents' domestic violence.
